nodes.description: uint256 MAX_SUPPLY = 500; hard cap on the total collection supply
uint256 SEED_NONCE = 0; monotonically incremented entropy counter mixed into hash generation
bool public MINTING_LIVE = false; public mint gate flag toggled by the owner
uint256 public finalBlock; block number after which minting is no longer allowed
mapping(address => bool) public whitelist; one-shot mint permission per address
uint256 public numWhitelisted; running count of whitelisted addresses
mapping(uint256 => string) internal tokenIdToHash; stored generative art hash per token
mapping(string => bool) hashToMinted; uniqueness guard ensuring no duplicate hashes are minted
mapping(uint256 => Trait[]) public traitTypes; trait name/type metadata per rarity tier
uint16[][10] TIERS; weighted rarity distribution tables per trait tier
string p5jsUrl; CDN location of the p5.js renderer embedded in token HTML
string p5jsIntegrity; subresource integrity hash for the p5.js resource
string imageUrl; base image url used in token metadata
string animationUrl; base animation url used in token metadata
internal mint path: checks MINTING_LIVE, whitelist, supply, finalBlock and EOA status, then hashes and calls _mint
public no-argument mint entrypoint that delegates to mintInternal
internal (state-mutating) recursive generator of the 11 digit trait hash using block.timestamp, block.difficulty, SEED_NONCE and rarityGen
internal view lookup mapping a 0-10000 random input onto a rarity index using TIERS
view helper returning true for the owner or for a whitelisted address
onlyOwner mint that generates a hash and mints the token to the dead address
onlyOwner bulk whitelist of an array of addresses and increment of numWhitelisted
onlyOwner append of Trait entries into traitTypes for a given tier index
onlyOwner wipe of all traitTypes entries
onlyOwner toggle of the MINTING_LIVE flag
onlyOwner setter of the p5jsUrl state variable
view that assembles the base64 on-chain JSON metadata with animation and image urls
view that decodes hash digits into a trait metadata JSON array via traitTypes
view that builds the data:text/html URI embedding the p5.js renderer and token hash
view returning the stored tokenIdToHash value for a token id
constructor that initializes ERC721 name/symbol, all TIERS tables, numWhitelisted and finalBlock
msg.sender; caller-controlled address flowing into mint gating, whitelist checks and hashing
block.timestamp; miner-influenced value used as entropy inside hash generation
ERC721 _mint/_safeMint path which performs an external callback to the recipient once the receiver is a contract
low-level external call to onERC721Received in ERC721._checkOnERC721Received, transfer of control to an untrusted receiver
address[] memory _users; caller-supplied batch of addresses in batchWhitelist
uint256 _traitTypeIndex; tier slot targeted by addTraitType
string memory _p5jsUrl; new renderer url in setJsAddress
uint256 _tokenId; token id argument consumed by tokenURI
local uint256 thisTokenId derived from totalSupply() in mintInternal/ownerMintForBurn
local string currentHash accumulated inside hash() before being stored

edges.reason: msg.sender drives the whitelist and EOA checks in mintInternal
msg.sender is fed into the hash entropy and re-entry guard logic
block.timestamp is used as randomness entropy inside hash()
msg.sender is compared against owner() and whitelist in isWhitelisted
msg.sender is used both for the onlyOwner check and hash generation in ownerMintForBurn
TIERS rarity tables are read to resolve a rarity index
SEED_NONCE is incremented and mixed into the hash entropy each iteration
hashToMinted is queried to avoid returning an already-minted hash
mintInternal marks the generated hash as minted
mintInternal stores the generated hash keyed by the new token id
mintInternal consumes and clears the caller whitelist entry
mintInternal enforces the MAX_SUPPLY cap
mintInternal enforces the finalBlock deadline
mintInternal checks the MINTING_LIVE gate
ownerMintForBurn writes the generated hash for the burned token id
ownerMintForBurn records the hash as minted
ownerMintForBurn respects the MAX_SUPPLY cap
batchWhitelist writes true entries into the whitelist mapping
batchWhitelist increments numWhitelisted by the array length
addTraitType pushes new Trait entries into traitTypes
clearTraits deletes traitTypes entries
flipMintingSwitch negates the MINTING_LIVE flag
setJsAddress overwrites the p5jsUrl state variable
tokenURI embeds the imageUrl base into the metadata
tokenURI embeds the animationUrl base into the metadata
hashToMetadata reads traitTypes to build the attribute array
hashToHTML embeds the p5jsUrl in the generated html
hashToHTML embeds the p5jsIntegrity SRI hash in the generated html
isWhitelisted reads the whitelist mapping for the queried address
constructor initializes all TIERS rarity tables
constructor sets finalBlock to the deployment block plus 192000
constructor zeroes numWhitelisted
owner-supplied address array parameter is iterated to fill the whitelist
tier index parameter selects which traitTypes slot is appended to
url parameter is written into the p5jsUrl state variable
token id parameter selects the hash used to build the metadata
thisTokenId local is derived from totalSupply and used for the new token
currentHash local accumulates the generated hash digits
mintFilament delegates execution to mintInternal
mintInternal calls hash() to derive the token artwork hash
ownerMintForBurn calls hash() to derive the token artwork hash
hash() calls rarityGen for each of the eleven hash digits
tokenURI calls _tokenIdToHash to fetch the stored hash
tokenURI calls hashToMetadata to build the attributes JSON
mintInternal forwards the mint to ERC721 _mint which may hand control to the recipient
ownerMintForBurn forwards the mint to ERC721 _mint which may hand control to the recipient
_mint triggers the onERC721Received callback on a contract recipient before state checks complete
a malicious receiver callback can re-enter the mint path while the whitelist flag is already consumed

normalization_plan.reason: address array parameter only feeds the batchWhitelist whitelist write loop and has no independent security meaning
tier index parameter only selects the traitTypes slot written by addTraitType
string parameter is immediately assigned to p5jsUrl inside setJsAddress
token id parameter is only used inside tokenURI to select the stored hash for metadata
local token id is computed from totalSupply() and consumed by mintInternal when emitting the new token
local accumulating string exists only within hash() as the returned hash candidate
